::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 7th 1892  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/19
:::

Dear Madam
I am sending your letter on to a lady who has an old servant in an institution such as you wish for - but I do not know how the appointment was made.  I am sending your letter to her and asking her ([Mrs Elgie](people/person_475.qmd)) to write to you if she knows whether there would be a chance of admission 

yours truly
C M Yonge
